SELECT co.iso2 AS code,
COALESCE(t.translation, co.name, co.native) COALESCE(co.name, co.native) AS name, COALESCE(co.native, co.name) AS nameLocal, co.phonecode AS phoneCode, co.currency AS currency, co.postal_code_format AS postalCodeFormat, co.postal_code_regex AS postalCodeRegex FROM countries co
LEFT JOIN translations t ON t.place_type = 'country' AND t.place_id = co.id AND t.language = #{language}
WHERE co.iso2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY co.name

SELECT co.iso2 AS code, COALESCE(co.name, co.native) AS name, COALESCE(co.native, co.name) AS nameLocal, co.phonecode AS phoneCode, co.currency AS currency, co.postal_code_format AS postalCodeFormat, co.postal_code_regex AS postalCodeRegex FROM countries co WHERE co.iso2 = #{country} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.iso3166_2, ''), CONCAT('S', s.id)) AS code,
COALESCE(t.translation, s.name, s.native) COALESCE(s.name, s.native) AS name, COALESCE(s.native, s.name) AS nameLocal, s.type AS type FROM states s
LEFT JOIN translations t ON t.place_type = 'state' AND t.place_id = s.id AND t.language = #{language}
WHERE s.country_code = #{country} AND (s.iso3166_2 = #{code} OR CONCAT('S', s.id) = #{code}) LIMIT 1
SELECT s.id FROM states s WHERE s.country_code = #{country} AND (s.iso3166_2 = #{code} OR CONCAT('S', s.id) = #{code}) LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: AND ( CASE WHEN c.country_code = 'CN' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM states st WHERE st.id = c.state_id AND st.type = 'municipality' ) THEN c.type = 'section' WHEN c.country_code = 'CN' THEN c.type = 'prefecture' ELSE c.type IN ('city', 'municipality', 'town', 'adm2') END ) AND (c.country_code <> 'CN' OR c.level IS NOT NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cities d WHERE d.state_id = c.state_id AND d.name = c.name AND d.type = c.type AND COALESCE(d.population, -1) = COALESCE(c.population, -1) AND d.id < c.id )
